gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: I want you to stop tapping your pen while I am working.
gaps.sentence: I ___ tapping your pen while I am working.
gaps.explanation: 'I want you to stop' becomes 'I wish you would stop' — wish + would for irritation.

gaps.lead: They cancelled the match because of the rain.
gaps.sentence: The match ___ because of the rain.

gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…
